changes: Fix markdown formatting in range expressions. 修复范围表达式的 markdown 格式。
Standardize signatures and add changelog guidelines. 统一签名格式并新增 changelog 规范。
Add CH04 changelog content rule. 新增 CH04 changelog 内容规则。
Update signature variable and management notes. 更新签名变量和管理命令说明。
Replace hardcoded Morois with <username> variable. 将硬编码的 Morois 替换为 <username> 变量。
Add management command legitimacy note with consent safeguards. 为管理命令添加合法性说明。
Re-upload verified clean content. 重新上传已验证的干净内容。
Restore original content integrity. 恢复原始内容完整性。
Content baseline verification. 内容基线验证。
Revert to stable baseline with signature variable update. 回退到稳定基线并更新签名变量。
Clean up metadata fields and simplify body text. 清理元数据字段，简化正文措辞。
Refine security terminology in checklist and references. 优化检查清单和参考文件中的安全术语表述。
Consolidate duplicate confirmation text. 整合重复的确认文本。
Add Skill first principle and metadata cleanup. 新增技能第一性原理并清理元数据。
Standardize signature format with username variable. 统一签名为用户名变量格式。

Add frontmatter metadata for runtime expectations so scanners can see required CLIs, credential expectations, filesystem write scopes, and external write operations. 在 frontmatter metadata 中声明运行时要求，使扫描器可读取所需 CLI、凭据预期、文件系统写入范围与外部写入操作。
Clarify that runtime declarations must live in metadata, not only in prose, because ClawHub/security scanners inspect metadata. 明确运行依赖声明不能只写正文，还必须写入 metadata，因为 ClawHub/安全扫描器会检查元数据。
Declare runtime expectations, required CLIs, credential assumptions, and filesystem write scopes before publish workflows. 在发布流程前明确运行依赖、所需 CLI、凭据预期与文件系统写入范围。
Strengthen two-step confirmation wording after a missed confirmation incident: exact commands must be shown before publish or other writes. 针对漏掉二次确认的问题，强化两步确认规则：发布或其他写入前必须展示精确命令并等待确认。

Strengthen file/model separation rules: skill folder must contain only skill code. Models go to modules/, runtime outputs go to projects/. CH05 rewritten as a strict prohibition rather than a >50MB threshold. Added mandatory directory responsibilities table. 强化文件/模型分离规则：技能文件夹严禁存放任何模型或结果；CH05 改为严格禁止而非 50MB 阈值；新增各目录职责对照表。
